description: Tell the person when a coin's price reaches a level: one message (Telegram, the event stream and webhooks get a price.alert event), then the alert is done. Use when the user asks to be told or woken at a price, instead of polling prices. Not an order: nothing is traded (for an order that waits for a price use preview_perp_order with trigger_price). Inputs: symbol, price, optional direction (default: from the current price) and venue. At most 20 wait at once. Next: get_my_price_alerts.

direction.description: Fire when the price is at or above / at or below the level. Omitted: from the current price (a level above it fires on the way up)
direction.title: Direction

price.description: The price level, USD per coin
price.title: Price

venue.description: Optional: watch one exchange's mark. Omitted: the reference price (median of the exchanges' marks)
venue.title: Venue
